description_en: Queries the list of edge routing records for a site
description_zh: 查询站点下的边缘路由记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-edge-routine-records --site-id 1234560000 --record-name a.example.com --record-match-type fuzzy --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEdgeRoutineRecords

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: Filters by the specified record name
parameters.name: record_name

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode used to filter by record name. Valid values:
fuzzy: fuzzy match.
prefix: prefix match.
suffix: suffix match.
exact: exact match (default)
parameters.help_zh:
按记录名称过滤，过滤匹配的模式：
fuzzy：模糊匹配。
prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配（默认）
parameters.name: record_match_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，第几页，取值大于等于 1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页大小，取值范围 1-500。默认值：500
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of records displayed per page

items.description_en: The information about a single record

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the record. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 记录的创建时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

RecordCname.description_en: The CNAME of the record. When the site uses CNAME access, this is the CNAME value that needs to be configured for the record
RecordCname.description_zh: 记录的CNAME。当站点的接入方式为CNAME接入时，需要为记录配置的CNAME值

SiteName.description_en: The name of the site to which the record belongs

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time of the record. The time is in ISO 8601 format and displayed in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
UpdateTime.description_zh: 记录的更新时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
